description: This file defines the ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable class, which manages implicit subscription mappings for streams in Orleans. It includes cache management, subscriber lookup, and predicate filtering logic related to stream namespace subscriptions.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable
classes.description: A class that maintains a table of implicit stream subscribers, handling cache updates, predicate matching, and subscriber retrieval based on stream namespaces.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable.Cache
classes.description: A nested class used internally to cache the current set of predicates, namespaces, and version information.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable.StreamSubscriber
classes.description: A nested class representing an individual stream subscriber with associated grain type and ID mapping logic.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable.StreamSubscriberPredicate
classes.description: A nested class pairing a stream subscriber with a namespace predicate for filtering applicable subscribers.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache, rebuilding it if underlying bindings have changed.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Constructs a new cache object from the current bindings and predicates.

methods.name: GetImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of subscription GUIDs to GrainIds for a given stream ID, based on implicit subscriptions.

methods.name: GetOrAddImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the set of implicit subscribers for a specified namespace.

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscriber
methods.description: Checks if a specific grainId is an implicit subscriber of a stream.

methods.name: TryGetImplicitSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Attempts to produce a unique subscription GUID for a grain and stream combination if implicit subscription exists.

methods.name: MakeSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Generates a unique subscription GUID based on grain type and stream ID parameters.

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscribeEligibleNameSpace
methods.description: Determines if a namespace is valid for implicit subscriptions.

methods.name: FindImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Filters and returns a set of subscribers matching a namespace predicate list.
